1130|2|10|700.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
1130|2|10|700.evidence: USI median +0.226 over 45 corners (27 understeer, 7 mid-corner front reds)

1130|2|10|700.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
1130|2|10|700.evidence: 14/45 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

1130|2|10|700.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
1130|2|10|700.evidence: 211 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

1130|2|10|700.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.

1130|2|10|700.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Trail-brake understeer: finish more braking before steering; caster +0.5 for camber-in-turn.

1130|2|10|700.text: Fronts lock first: brake balance 2-4% rearward.

1130|2|10|700.text: Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.45) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
